svg.aria-label: Layered architecture: surfaces compile to one statement, routing resolves a key to a leaf, the leaf serializes writes behind a watermark, storage seals immutable coded segments.
svg.title: sdev1 architecture
svg.desc: Four layers. Every caller surface compiles to a single query statement. Routing resolves a key to a leaf by longest prefix. The leaf holds one fenced writer, a live tail and a published watermark. Storage seals immutable blocks and erasure-codes them into stripes.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
